description:
Send a program compiled on the visitor's machine (Intel HEX text, 48 KiB at most, e.g. arduino-cli's
    <sketch>.ino.hex) to the human's browser, which loads it in the simulator without compiling and, if run, starts it.
    files: the sources, shown read-only in the editor, never compiled. During a turn on a real bench, the bench gets it
    too. Prefer it to push_to_editor, which is the fallback when the local toolchain is missing.
name: push_program
title: Push a compiled program
